hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom curve AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that routes swaps entirely through Euler Finance EVaults, using its own pricing curve (CurveLib/QuoteLib) and reserve tracking instead of Uniswap's CLMM. The hook returns a BeforeSwapDelta to override pool accounting, deposits input tokens into Euler vaults, and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults. Each hook instance is a minimal proxy delegating to a shared EulerSwap implementation; native CLMM liquidity and direct pool initialization are blocked.
